title: [Audit] Failed authentications and denied access
description: authentication_failed, realm_authentication_failed and anonymous_access_denied — the classic intrusion signal.
esql: FROM logs-serverless.audit.otel-elastic_cloud | WHERE attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_failed","realm_authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied") OR attributes.event.outcome == "failure" | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | KEEP @timestamp, actor, attributes.event.action, attributes.event.outcome, attributes.authentication.type, client.ip, client.geo.country_iso_code, attributes.url.path | SORT @timestamp DESC
